answer_1.quote: Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA) aims to automatically answer natural language questions via well-structured facts stored in Knowledge Graphs (KGs).
answer_1.outputs: The output is a natural language answer corresponding to one or more entities in the knowledge graph, formatted as a bar-separated list: <Ans1>|<Ans2>|...|<AnsN>.

answer_2.quote: D-RAG employs Hits@1 and F1 metrics for evaluation on WebQSP and CWQ.
